_comment: Morris screening design over ResiFlow's non-data parameters (audit Section 6, HANDOFF_resiflow_sensitivity_analysis.md). Consumed by scripts/6_morris_screening.py. Targets: a dotted path sets a unified_parameters.json value directly; a '_scales:' prefix multiplies the existing value (dict targets move every numeric leaf coherently); a 'special:' prefix is a dispatcher-level handle recorded in the run's overrides.json under '_dispatch' (inert to the parameter loader). Stage codes: P=preprocess (network rebuild), 1=baseline assignment (expensive), 2=hazard intersection, 3=damage algebra (cheap), 4=recovery/rerouting loop. Report mu*/sigma per output component separately - never a composite.
preconditions: Determinism: pin flow-assignment ordering/seeds (imap_unordered nondeterminism inflates sigma). Blocking fix before production runs.
Dispatcher must assert RESIFLOW_MAX_FLOW_ITERATIONS and RESIFLOW_SAMPLE_OD_N are unset for production SA runs.

factors.name: vot_scale
factors.note: One multiplier over all vehicle-class VOT values (moves the tier-keyed dict coherently).

factors.name: car_occupancy
factors.note: Baseline 1.67 is NHTS all-purpose, not commute (~1.18) - value-level issue flagged in unified_parameters.json; do not change baseline mid-SA.

factors.name: fuel_price_scale
factors.note: EIA pump-price envelope as a scale over the per-class fuel price dict.

factors.name: non_fuel_opcost_scale
factors.note: Scales every a/b coefficient of the non-fuel operating-cost curves coherently.

factors.name: isolation_usd_per_day_scale
factors.note: Freight isolation monetization is a flagged open research question - parameterized (5.5.3), not resolved.

factors.name: capacity_scale
factors.note: Scales per-lane-per-hour capacity in edge_init (both the link-column and tier-profile branches).

factors.name: breakpoint_scale
factors.note: Scales the speed-decay onset flow (breakpoint_flows).

factors.name: effective_hours_per_day
factors.note: Daily capacity multiplier / hourly-flow divisor (was hardcoded 24 in edge_init and update_edge_speed).

factors.name: congestion_scale
factors.note: Scales the per-tier speed-flow congestion slope in update_edge_speed.

factors.name: congestion_model_family
factors.note: Dispatcher switch: 0 = linear speed-decay path (road_revised), 1 = BPR path (assignment/ue_bpr).

factors.name: speed_shift_mph
factors.note: Additive free-flow speed shift, floored at the per-tier minimum speed.

factors.name: flood_closure_threshold_cm
factors.note: Closure depth x_d for cars; literature spans ~15-60 cm.

factors.name: speed_depth_exponent
factors.note: p in V = V_max*(1 - d/d_c)**p; p=2 is the Pregnolato quadratic, p=1 the linear alternate (5.2).

factors.name: damage_threshold_scale
factors.note: Multiplies every categorical depth threshold in fragility/flood_categorical.py (5.5.5).

factors.name: curve_theta
factors.note: Convex low/high-flow damage-curve mixing (resiflow.sa.curves.mix_damage_curves; 5.2).

factors.name: depth_scale_lambda
factors.note: Depth-axis stretch: curves evaluated at depth/lambda (damage-onset uncertainty; orthogonal to theta).

factors.name: road_cost_scale
factors.note: Tier A once the cost-workbook GBP/USD relabel audit resolves; until then treated as blocked-C with a wide scale (Section 6 footnote). Applied to road+tunnel unit costs after workbook load (5.5.6).

factors.name: bridge_cost_scale
factors.note: Applied to bridge-surface and bridge-river unit costs after workbook load (5.5.6).

factors.name: recovery_pathway
factors.note: Dispatcher switch over the existing fast/average/slow recovery-design scenario loop.

factors.name: recovery_gate_scale
factors.note: Scales the 2 m / 6 m residual-floodwater gates coherently (5.5.4). The recession window itself (4-14 d) is governed by the recovery design table; vary it via special:recession_window_days in the dispatcher if a variant table is provided - workbooks/tables stay pristine.

factors.name: freight_demand_scale
factors.note: Global OD demand multiplier (already wired).

factors.name: payload_scale
factors.note: Tons-per-truck payload factors live in the freight-disaggregation input tables; the dispatcher applies the scale after loading (tables stay pristine).

factors.name: weekday_factor
factors.note: Annual-to-weekday conversion factor in the freight disaggregation; dispatcher-applied.

factors.name: faf5_default_lanes
factors.note: Fallback lane count for links missing lane data (already wired).

factors.name: faf5_meters_per_lane
factors.note: Lane width in meters (already wired; US standard 3.6-3.7 m, envelope 3.0-4.3).

excluded.name: fuel_curve_scale
excluded.reason: FUEL_LITRE_PER_KM / non_fuel_cost_coeffs are the original UK NIRD per-km coefficients (comments corrected 2026-08: code consistently evaluates per-km curves at km/h and multiplies by distance_km). Still blocked: values are UK-legacy pending FHWA HERS extraction, and the non-fuel /100 step's currency labeling (pence->GBP consumed as USD) is unresolved. Perturbing a quantity with unresolved provenance/currency is meaningless until replaced.
